sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode deals with a crime committed against a child, but won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目讲述了一起针对儿童的犯罪，可能并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: On Sunday, October 5th, 1975, April Mollseed was making her way through a list of chores in her home on Delamere Road in Rochdale,
sentences.zh: 1975年10月5日星期日，阿普丽尔·莫尔西德正在罗奇代尔德拉米尔路家中做着各种家务。

sentences.en: a town at the foothills of the Moor countryside in northern England.
sentences.zh: 罗奇代尔是英格兰北部荒原山麓的一座城镇。

sentences.en: As she prepared supper that day around noon, April realised she didn't have any bread, so she decided to send one of her kids on a quick errand to the nearby corner store.
sentences.zh: 那天中午左右准备晚饭时，阿普丽尔发现家里没有面包了，于是她决定派她的一个孩子去附近的拐角商店跑个腿。

sentences.en: The Mollseed family had a job roster in place for the three children, Laura, Fred and Leslie.
sentences.zh: 莫尔西德家为三个孩子劳拉、弗雷德和莱斯利制定了一份值日表。

sentences.en: It listed certain chores each one was responsible for to help out around the house.
sentences.zh: 上面列出了每个人负责打扫屋子的特定家务。

sentences.en: According to the roster, it was 12-year-old Fred's turn to run errands.
sentences.zh: 根据值日表，轮到12岁的弗雷德去跑腿。

sentences.en: However, Fred wasn't home that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 然而，弗雷德那天下午不在家。

sentences.en: He was at football practice.
sentences.zh: 他在参加足球训练。

sentences.en: So next in line for the job was 11-year-old Leslie.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来轮到11岁的莱斯利。

sentences.en: April shouted for Leslie, whom she affectionately called Lel.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔大声叫着莱斯利，亲切地称呼她为莱尔。

sentences.en: Her familiar Scottish accent rang out to where Leslie played with her 13-year-old sister, Laura.
sentences.zh: 她那熟悉的苏格兰口音传到了莱斯利和13岁姐姐劳拉玩耍的地方。

sentences.en: Moments later, Leslie appeared before her mother.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，莱斯利出现在母亲面前。

sentences.en: April instructed Leslie to go fetch bread and air freshener.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔吩咐莱斯利去买面包和空气清新剂。

sentences.en: Leslie kicked her feet and protested.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利跺着脚表示抗议。

sentences.en: It wasn't her turn to go to the shops.
sentences.zh: 轮到她去商店了。

sentences.en: It was Fred's.
sentences.zh: 应该是弗雷德的。

sentences.en: April encouraged Leslie with a small reward.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔用一点小奖励鼓励莱斯利。

sentences.en: Leslie playfully asked for sixpence payment to complete the task.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利开玩笑地要求给六便士作为跑腿的报酬。

sentences.en: Her mother bargained her down to three.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲把价格砍到了三便士。

sentences.en: April gave Leslie a one-pound note to buy the items, and Leslie tucked the money in a sparkly purple sequined purse.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔给了莱斯利一张一镑纸币去买东西，莱斯利把钱塞进了一个闪亮的紫色亮片钱包里。

sentences.en: Her mother also handed her a navy blue canvas shopping bag with the Tweety Bird character on its side.
sentences.zh: 她母亲还递给她一个海军蓝帆布购物袋，侧面印着崔弟鸟的图案。

sentences.en: With autumn while underway, Leslie stacked layers on her small frame to ward off the crisp chill air.
sentences.zh: 由于深秋已至，莱斯利在她瘦小的身躯上叠穿了好几层衣服，以抵御清凉的寒意。

sentences.en: She wore a blue woolen jumper over a red and white t-shirt, a pink skirt, and brown shoes.
sentences.zh: 她身穿一件红白T恤外搭蓝色羊毛套头衫、一条粉色短裙和棕色鞋子。

sentences.en: She pulled socks up her thin legs.
sentences.zh: 她把袜子拉到纤细的腿上。

sentences.en: They were blue and white tartan, decorated with her idols, Scottish pop band the Bay City Rollers.
sentences.zh: 那是蓝白相间的格子袜，上面印着她的偶像——苏格兰流行乐队贝城溜冰者。

sentences.en: She wrapped herself in a blue raincoat, lifting the hood over her mop of curly brown hair.
sentences.zh: 她裹上一件蓝色雨衣，把帽子拉到她那一头卷曲的棕色头发上。

sentences.en: The sight of her youngest daughter, all tucked up in her coat, with her hood on and socks pulled up, made April laugh.
sentences.zh: 看到小女儿把自己裹在雨衣里，戴着兜帽，拉着袜子，阿普丽尔笑了起来。

sentences.en: To April, Leslie was her little darling, generous, kind-hearted, and enchanting to be around.
sentences.zh: 对阿普丽尔来说，莱斯利是她的宝贝，慷慨、善良，和她在一起令人陶醉。

sentences.en: And compared to her other children, April was more protective of Leslie.
sentences.zh: 与其他孩子相比，阿普丽尔对莱斯利更加保护。

sentences.en: Leslie had suffered ill health since birth, born with a congenital cardiac condition.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利自出生起就身体不好，患有先天性心脏病。

sentences.en: At age three, she received open-heart surgery to fix a faulty valve, but her body never fully recovered.
sentences.zh: 三岁时，她接受了心脏直视手术来修复有缺陷的瓣膜，但她的身体从未完全恢复。

sentences.en: Her illness had suppressed her physical and mental growth.
sentences.zh: 她的病情抑制了她的身体和智力发育。

sentences.en: By age 11, Leslie stood barely four feet high, weighed just 25 kilograms, and assessments revealed she had the mental age equivalent to that of a six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 到了11岁，莱斯利身高刚满四英尺，体重仅25公斤，评估显示她的智力相当于六岁儿童。

sentences.en: At times, Leslie's poor health would make her frail and lethargic, confining her to the house.
sentences.zh: 有时，糟糕的健康状况会使莱斯利虚弱嗜睡，只能呆在家里。

sentences.en: With little energy to do much else, she'd sit by the window and watch as other children played outside.
sentences.zh: 由于没有什么精力做别的，她会坐在窗前，看着其他孩子在外面玩耍。

sentences.en: So when Leslie was feeling well, she fully embraced the day, taking nothing for granted.
sentences.zh: 因此，当莱斯利感觉身体好些时，她会充分拥抱每一天，对一切都不视为理所当然。

sentences.en: Even just running a quick, simple errand for her mum was an adventure she eagerly took on.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只是为妈妈跑一趟简单的小腿，也是她热切投入的一次冒险。

sentences.en: April harboured no sense of concern, allowing Leslie to take the short walk to the shops alone that Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔并没有感到任何担忧，允许莱斯利在那个周日下午独自步行去商店。

sentences.en: They lived in the council housing estate of Turf Hill, on the southeastern fringe of Rochdale.
sentences.zh: 他们住在罗奇代尔东南边缘的特夫山市政住宅区。

sentences.en: A predominantly residential town, Rochdale is nestled in the wide valley of the River Roach, just over 15 kilometres northeast of the city of Manchester.
sentences.zh: 罗奇代尔是一个以住宅为主的小镇，坐落在罗奇河宽阔的山谷中，在曼彻斯特市东北部仅15公里多一点的地方。

sentences.en: Its skyline is dotted with former cotton mills, a constant reminder of its rich history of textile manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 它的天际线上点缀着前棉纺厂，这是其悠久纺织制造业历史的不断提醒。

sentences.en: An industrial revolution boom in the 19th century required the city to quickly expand and urbanise, turning the untouched country land surrounds into dense housing estates.
sentences.zh: 19世纪工业革命的繁荣要求该市迅速扩张和城市化，将周围未受破坏的乡村土地变成密集的住宅区。

sentences.en: Turf Hill estate consisted mostly of working families similar to the Mulseids.
sentences.zh: 特夫山住宅区主要由像莫尔西德一家这样的工薪家庭组成。

sentences.en: They lived on long streets in matching double-storey red-brick terrace houses with small front gardens, framed by picket fences and low shrub hedges.
sentences.zh: 他们住在长街上相配的双层红砖排屋里，前面有小花园，周围是尖桩栅栏和低矮的灌木篱笆。

sentences.en: The local community was self-contained and close-knit.
sentences.zh: 当地社区是自给自足且紧密联系的。

sentences.en: These families had come to know each other well over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些家庭多年来彼此非常熟悉。

sentences.en: Their children attended the same schools, youth clubs and sporting activities.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子上同一所学校、青年俱乐部和体育活动。

sentences.en: Neighbours were friendly and familiar.
sentences.zh: 邻居们都很友好且熟悉。

sentences.en: Local pubs, shops and parties were full of recognisable faces.
sentences.zh: 当地的酒吧、商店和派对到处都是认得的面孔。

sentences.en: Nobody was a stranger.
sentences.zh: 没有人是陌生人。

sentences.en: Most Turf Hill residents knew Leslie Mulseid.
sentences.zh: 大多数特夫山居民都认识莱斯利·莫尔西德。

sentences.en: Noticeably smaller and sickly than her peers, she was easily recognisable around town.
sentences.zh: 由于比同龄人明显更矮且多病，她在镇上很容易被认出来。

sentences.en: Despite her ailments, those who crossed paths with Leslie met an optimistic, spirited young girl with a friendly impulse to flash her gap-toothed smile and greet everyone she saw.
sentences.zh: 尽管有病痛，但与莱斯利擦肩而过的人都会遇到一个乐观、有精神的年轻女孩，她有着友好冲动的习惯，总是露出缺牙的微笑向见到的每个人打招呼。

sentences.en: It was around 12.30pm when Leslie headed out the front door of her family home on Delamere Road.
sentences.zh: 大约中午12点30分，莱斯利走出了德拉米尔路家中的前门。

sentences.en: Laura watched her younger sister leave from a window upstairs and asked where she was going.
sentences.zh: 劳拉从楼上的窗户看着妹妹离开，问她要去哪里。

sentences.en: To the shop, Leslie responded.
sentences.zh: 去商店，莱斯利回答说。

sentences.en: April told her daughter to return home quickly.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔告诉女儿快点回家。

sentences.en: Leslie replied that she would be back soon.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利回答说她很快就会回来。

sentences.en: One hour had passed since April Mulseid had sent her daughter Leslie out to fetch bread, and she hadn't returned home yet.
sentences.zh: 自阿普丽尔·莫尔西德派女儿莱斯利去买面包以来已经过去了一个小时，她还没有回家。

sentences.en: The errand shouldn't have taken her so long.
sentences.zh: 跑腿本不应该花这么长时间。

sentences.en: April considered what might be holding Leslie up.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔琢磨着是什么耽误了莱斯利。

sentences.en: The Mulseid's pet cat, Jinxie, had recently gone missing.
sentences.zh: 莫尔西德家的宠物猫金克西最近失踪了。

sentences.en: Perhaps Leslie had gone searching for the cat during her trip.
sentences.zh: 也许莱斯利在路上去找猫了。

sentences.en: Maybe she'd run into a friend and gotten distracted.
sentences.zh: 也许她遇到了朋友分心了。

sentences.en: Or she might be at the store debating what sweets she'd spend her three pence on.
sentences.zh: 或者她可能在店里纠结该把三便士花在什么糖果上。

sentences.en: April wasn't too worried.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔并不是很担心。

sentences.en: Leslie could be a little rascal at times.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利有时会像个淘气鬼。

sentences.en: If anything, April was just frustrated Leslie had disobeyed her order to hurry home.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么的话，阿普丽尔只是对莱斯利没有听从她快点回家的命令感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Leslie's older sister, Laura, was sent out to find her.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利的姐姐劳拉被派出去找她。

sentences.en: Tracing what she believed was Leslie's likely route to the corner shops, she headed to a grocery store called Riders, where Leslie had most likely gone.
sentences.zh: 她沿着她认为莱斯利去拐角商店的可能路线走去，前往一家名叫里德斯的杂货店，莱斯利最可能是去了那里。

sentences.en: When Laura arrived, she found the store was closed on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 当劳拉到达时，她发现这家店周日不开门。

sentences.en: That meant Leslie would have continued on a little further down Ansdell Road to a convenience store called Spa.
sentences.zh: 这意味着莱斯利会继续往前走一点，沿着安斯德尔路走到一家名为斯帕的便利店。

sentences.en: Yet, when Laura arrived there, Leslie was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 然而，当劳拉赶到那里时，根本不见莱斯利的踪影。

sentences.en: Laura suspected her younger sister might have bypassed the bread buying altogether.
sentences.zh: 劳拉怀疑她的小妹妹可能根本没去买面包。

sentences.en: Leslie was a regular at a nearby confectionery shop on Broad Lane called Margaret's.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利是布罗德巷上一家名为玛格丽特的附近糖果店的常客。

sentences.en: But there was no luck there either.
sentences.zh: 但那里也没有运气。

sentences.en: And Laura returned home alone.
sentences.zh: 劳拉只好独自回家。

sentences.en: April stood by the front gate, checking the road in both directions, expecting to see Leslie's hooded figure turn the corner at any moment.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔站在前门，朝两边张望马路，期望随时能看到莱斯利戴着兜帽的身影转过街角。

sentences.en: She wondered if Leslie had gotten herself heard or loSt.
sentences.zh: 她想知道莱斯利是不是听到了什么声音或者迷路了。

sentences.en: By now, Leslie's older brother, Fred, had arrived home from football practice, and he agreed to go with Laura and continue the search.
sentences.zh: 此时，莱斯利的哥哥弗雷德已经结束足球训练回到家，他同意和劳拉一起继续搜寻。

sentences.en: Together they combed the local streets, but found no sign of Leslie.
sentences.zh: 他们一起搜寻了当地的街道，但没有发现莱斯利的踪迹。

sentences.en: It had been almost an hour and a half since she'd left home to go to the store.
sentences.zh: 她离家去商店已经将近一个半小时了。

sentences.en: With no clues to point to where she was, Fred rushed to get their stepfather.
sentences.zh: 没有任何线索指出她在哪里，弗雷德赶忙去找他们的继父。

sentences.en: Danny Mollseed was a maintenance electrician who worked shift work at an engineering factory.
sentences.zh: 丹尼·莫尔西德是一名维修电工，在一家工程工厂做轮班工作。

sentences.en: With work done for the day, Danny was spending the Sunday afternoon at the Plough Inn, drinking and playing darts, when Fred showed up with the news Leslie was missing.
sentences.zh: 结束了一天的工作后，丹尼正在犁头客栈度过周日下午，喝着酒打着飞镖，这时弗雷德跑来带来了莱斯利失踪的消息。

sentences.en: The last time Danny had seen Leslie was 7.45 that morning.
sentences.zh: 丹尼最后一次见到莱斯利是那天早上7点45分。

sentences.en: Leslie was still fast asleep in bed when he checked in on her before he left to catch the bus to work.
sentences.zh: 在他出门赶公交车去上班前去看她时，莱斯利还在床上熟睡。

sentences.en: Danny had a deep fondness and close attachment to Leslie.
sentences.zh: 丹尼对莱斯利有着深厚的喜爱和亲密的依恋。

sentences.en: He'd been her stepfather since she was a baby and was always by her side during her multiple doctor visits and hospital stays.
sentences.zh: 自从她还是个婴儿时起他就是她的继父，在她多次看医生和住院期间一直陪伴在她身旁。

sentences.en: He considered Leslie his own daughter.
sentences.zh: 他把莱斯利当成自己的亲生女儿。

sentences.en: Danny began his own search for Leslie, calling her name down every street.
sentences.zh: 丹尼开始了自己寻找莱斯利的行动，在每条街上大声喊着她的名字。

sentences.en: As he closed in on the spa convenience store, Danny was overwhelmed by an unshakable worry.
sentences.zh: 当他靠近斯帕便利店时，丹尼被一种挥之不去的担忧压得透不过气来。

sentences.en: His movement quickened and his voice became louder.
sentences.zh: 他的步伐加快了，声音也变大了。

sentences.en: He peered over fences, ran through gardens, opened up sheds in backyards.
sentences.zh: 他探头看着栅栏，穿过花园，打开后院的棚屋。

sentences.en: He pounded the doors of nearby homes, asking confused residents if they had seen Leslie.
sentences.zh: 他敲打着附近房屋的门，向困惑的居民询问是否见过莱斯利。

sentences.en: No one had.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过。

sentences.en: Although she was not the type to talk to strangers,
sentences.zh: 虽然她不是那种会跟陌生人说话的人，

sentences.en: Leslie was a friendly kid who would stop and talk to people she recognised.
sentences.zh: 但莱斯利是个友好的孩子，会停下来和她认得的人说话。

sentences.en: So Danny questioned passers-by, hoping to track Leslie via those she may have spoken to.
sentences.zh: 所以丹尼盘问了路人，希望能通过莱斯利可能交谈过的人来追踪她的踪迹。

sentences.en: But she had left no trail.
sentences.zh: 但她没有留下任何足迹。

sentences.en: At 3pm, Danny and April contacted Rochdale Police.
sentences.zh: 下午3点，丹尼和阿普丽尔联系了罗奇代尔警方。

sentences.en: Officers arrived to the Mulsade family home and questioned April extensively to determine Leslie's character, habits, behaviour and friends.
sentences.zh: 警官们赶到莫尔西德一家的住所，对阿普丽尔进行了详尽的盘问，以确定莱斯利的性格、习惯、行为和朋友。

sentences.en: Despite Leslie's developmental delays, she was otherwise an ordinary child.
sentences.zh: 尽管莱斯利发育迟缓，但她各方面都和其他普通孩子一样。

sentences.en: She enjoyed going to school, and when feeling up to it, she would participate in class games, physical education and swimming.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢去学校，在身体吃得消的时候，她会参加课堂游戏、体育课和游泳。

sentences.en: She loved her family, sisters, brother and pets.
sentences.zh: 她爱她的家人、姐妹、兄弟和宠物。

sentences.en: So it did seem out of character for her to not want to return home.
sentences.zh: 所以她不想回家确实有点反常。

sentences.en: Although she could be a bit of a rascal at times, the possibility she was playing a prank or pushing boundaries didn't sit right with those who knew her.
sentences.zh: 虽然她有时会有点淘气，但她是在恶作剧或试探底线的可能性在认识她的人看来并不成立。

sentences.en: Police sought witnesses who may have seen Leslie walking around the Turf Hill estate that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁目击者提供线索，看那天下午是否有人看到莱斯利在特夫山住宅区附近行走。

sentences.en: A child who lived on Delamere Road told police she was swinging on the gate out the front of her home when she saw Leslie leave her house around 12.30 and walk to the end of the street,
sentences.zh: 一个住在德拉米尔路的孩子告诉警察，她当时正坐在自家门前的栅栏上荡秋千，看到莱斯利12点30分左右离开家，走到街头，

sentences.en: where she turned left into Stuyops Lane.
sentences.zh: 在那里她左转进入了斯图尤普斯巷。

sentences.en: The area around Stuyops Lane was busy that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午斯图尤普斯巷附近非常热闹。

sentences.en: Crowds of children and families had gathered on the adjacent grassy fields of Kingsway Park for Sunday afternoon sporting activities.
sentences.zh: 成群的儿童和家庭聚集在京士威公园毗邻的草坪上进行周日下午的体育活动。

sentences.en: Five people who were traversing to and from the park recalled seeing Leslie walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 五个往返于公园的人回忆说看到莱斯利走在街上。

sentences.en: One of those was 10-year-old Bernadette Hegarty, who was Leslie's neighbour.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是10岁的伯纳黛特·赫加蒂，她是莱斯利的邻居。

sentences.en: She too was heading to the corner shops that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午她也是去拐角商店。

sentences.en: Leslie caught her eye, swinging her blue shopping bag and crossing Turf Hill Road.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利引起了她的注意，手里甩着蓝色购物袋，正横穿特夫山路。

sentences.en: Bernadette headed down Ansdell Road, a busy suburban road lined with houses and on which the sparse storefront was located.
sentences.zh: 伯纳黛特沿着安斯德尔路走去，这是一条繁忙的住宅街道，两旁林立着房屋，稀疏的店面也坐落于此。

sentences.en: Leslie headed down Stuyops Lane, which ran parallel to Ansdell Road, but cut behind the rears of the houses.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利走进了斯图尤普斯巷，这条巷子与安斯德尔路平行，但从房屋后方穿过。

sentences.en: Leslie was taking the back streets to the store, and Bernadette lost sight of her.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利走的是小巷去商店，伯纳黛特看不到她了。

sentences.en: More witness accounts placed Leslie in Stuyops Lane.
sentences.zh: 更多的目击证词证实莱斯利曾在斯图尤普斯巷出现。

sentences.en: A new resident to the area, who didn't know Leslie personally, recalled crossing paths with a little girl in a blue hooded raincoat.
sentences.zh: 一个该地区的新居民，并不认识莱斯利，回忆起曾和一个穿着蓝色兜帽雨衣的小女孩擦肩而过。

sentences.en: Thirteen-year-old Anita Rowan had just purchased some sweets from the spa shop and began walking down Ansdell Road towards her home on Turf Hill Road.
sentences.zh: 13岁的安妮塔·罗万刚从斯帕商店买了一些糖果，开始沿着安斯德尔路走向她在特夫山路的家。

sentences.en: The local roads in the estate were intersected by narrow walkways, known as snickets, used as shortcuts between the streets.
sentences.zh: 住宅区当地的街道被狭窄的人行道交错分割，被称为小巷，用作街道之间的捷径。

sentences.en: Anita saw Leslie down a snicket that led into Stuyops Lane.
sentences.zh: 安妮塔看到莱斯利在一条通往斯图尤普斯巷的小巷里。

sentences.en: The two girls acknowledged each other and continued on their separate ways.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩互相打了招呼，然后各自朝不同的方向走去。

sentences.en: Another girl witnessed this interaction.
sentences.zh: 另一个女孩目睹了这次互动。

sentences.en: When Leslie's neighbour Bernadette reached the corner store, she assumed Leslie wasn't far behind.
sentences.zh: 当莱斯利的邻居伯纳黛特到达拐角商店时，她以为莱斯利就在后面不远处。

sentences.en: They were walking adjacent paths to the same location.
sentences.zh: 他们走的是相邻的路线去同一个地方。

sentences.en: A fifteen-year-old boy was also inside the store shopping at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时店里还有一个15岁的男孩在购物。

sentences.en: Neither he nor Bernadette recalled ever seeing Leslie arrive.
sentences.zh: 他和伯纳黛特都不记得曾看到莱斯利到达。

sentences.en: The owners of the spa convenience store didn't see Leslie that afternoon either.
sentences.zh: 斯帕便利店的老板那天下午也没有看到莱斯利。

sentences.en: The owners of Margaret's, the confectionery shop on Broad Lane, were also questioned.
sentences.zh: 布罗德巷糖果店玛格丽特的老板也被盘问了。

sentences.en: And they couldn't remember if Leslie had visited.
sentences.zh: 他们也记不清莱斯利是否来过。

sentences.en: This meant the last confirmed sighting of Leslie was on Stuyops Lane.
sentences.zh: 这意味着最后一次确认看到莱斯利是在斯图尤普斯巷。

sentences.en: When the search party hit the area, there was a collective sense of unease.
sentences.zh: 当搜救队到达该地区时，有一种集体的不安感。

sentences.en: The section of Stuyops Lane Leslie had wandered through was stark contrast to the area in which she had come.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利徘徊的那段斯图尤普斯巷与她之前来的地方形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: The busy, populated road lined with housefronts and wide-open parkland, funnelled into a narrow alleyway.
sentences.zh: 这条两旁有房屋正面和开阔公园的繁忙人口稠密道路，汇聚成了一条狭窄的小巷。

sentences.en: After a few hundred metres, it met up with the turn of Buxton Crescent and opened into a high-traffic road again.
sentences.zh: 几百米后，它与巴克斯顿新月路的转弯处汇合，重新通向一条交通繁忙的道路。

sentences.en: But in this small section of laneway, there was no traffic.
sentences.zh: 但在小巷的这一小段里，没有任何车辆。

sentences.en: It was barely wide enough for a single car to slowly drive down.
sentences.zh: 它窄得几乎只能容纳一辆车缓慢通过。

sentences.en: Lining both sides were the tall timber fences that encased the backyards of surrounding homes.
sentences.zh: 两侧都是环绕着周围住宅后院的高木栅栏。

sentences.en: It was a quiet, secluded path, completely enclosed and hidden from view.
sentences.zh: 这是一条安静、偏僻的小路，完全封闭且隐藏在视线之外。

sentences.en: Based on witness statements, police were convinced Leslie didn't make it to the shops that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 根据目击者的证词，警方确信莱斯利那天下午根本没有走到商店。

sentences.en: Something must have happened to her in Stuyops Lane between 12.30 and 1.30pm, causing her to deviate from her errand.
sentences.zh: 在下午12点30分到1点30分之间，她一定在斯蒂奥普斯巷遭遇了什么，导致她偏离了买东西的路线。

sentences.en: The alleyway's overwhelming sense of isolation raised concerns.
sentences.zh: 这条小巷那种令人窒息的孤立感引发了人们的担忧。

sentences.en: But there were no signs of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 但现场没有任何遭到不法侵害的迹象。

sentences.en: So there was still the possibility Leslie was fine.
sentences.zh: 所以莱斯利安然无恙的可能性仍然存在。

sentences.en: Police door-knocked nearby houses, hoping someone may have seen or heard something.
sentences.zh: 警方对附近的房屋进行了逐门走访，希望能有人看到或听到些什么。

sentences.en: A resident of Stuyops Lane told police she was standing at her kitchen window when she glimpsed Leslie walk paSt.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂奥普斯巷的一位居民告诉警方，她当时正站在厨房窗前，无意间瞥见莱斯利从门前走过。

sentences.en: She also recalled noticing a small yellow van that looked to be tailing Leslie.
sentences.zh: 她还回忆说，注意到有一辆小型黄色面包车似乎在尾随莱斯利。

sentences.en: It was concerning, but police had to consider the encounter could be innocent.
sentences.zh: 这确实令人担忧，但警方不得不考虑到这种偶遇也可能是无意的。

sentences.en: Most people would slow down behind a child on a narrow street.
sentences.zh: 大多数人在狭窄的街道上遇到儿童时都会减速。

sentences.en: As daylight faded, the search for Leslie intensified.
sentences.zh: 随着天色渐暗，搜寻莱斯利的行动也在加紧。

sentences.en: The assumption Leslie might seek shelter for the cold night resulted in searches of garages, cars, sheds, drains, as well as abandoned houses.
sentences.zh: 由于推测莱斯利可能会寻找地方躲避寒冷的夜晚，搜寻范围扩大到了车库、汽车、棚屋、排水沟以及废弃的房屋。

sentences.en: The search radius expanded to farm and wasteland beyond the edges of the estate.
sentences.zh: 搜寻半径进一步扩大到了庄园边缘以外的农田和荒地。

sentences.en: Still, there was no sign of Leslie.
sentences.zh: 然而，依然没有莱斯利的半点踪迹。

sentences.en: It was a sleepless night for the Mollseeds.
sentences.zh: 对莫尔西德一家来说，这是一个不眠之夜。

sentences.en: By dawn the following morning of Monday October 6, the search recommenced.
sentences.zh: 次日清晨，即10月6日星期一，搜寻工作重新开始。

sentences.en: Police cars toured Turf Hill Estate, announcing information over their speakers about Leslie Mollseeds' disappearance and description.
sentences.zh: 警车在特夫希尔庄园巡逻，通过喇叭播报关于莱斯利·莫尔西德失踪的信息和体貌特征。

sentences.en: As news spread, rumours followed.
sentences.zh: 随着消息的传播，各种谣言也随之而起。

sentences.en: Talk arose of unknown men seen driving around town, propositioning local females and enticing children into their cars.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，看到有陌生男子开车在镇上四处游荡，向当地女性搭讪，并诱骗儿童上车。

sentences.en: With this in mind, focus returned to the last place Leslie was seen.
sentences.zh: 带着这些情况，人们的注意力重新回到了最后见到莱斯利的地方。

sentences.en: Stuyops Lane.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂奥普斯巷。

sentences.en: But the simple fact was, there had been no reports of a scuffle, screaming, running footsteps, the acceleration of a car engine,
sentences.zh: 但简单的事实是，没有任何人报告过发生过打斗、尖叫、奔跑的脚步声、汽车发动机的轰鸣声，

sentences.en: or anything that could suggest Leslie met with danger there.
sentences.zh: 或是任何暗示莱斯利在那里遭遇危险的迹象。

sentences.en: Three long days passed with no news.
sentences.zh: 漫长的三天过去了，依然没有任何消息。

sentences.en: By the night of Tuesday October 7, hopes had faded.
sentences.zh: 到了10月7日星期二晚上，希望已经破灭。

sentences.en: It seemed as though every possible location was checked and rechecked.
sentences.zh: 似乎所有可能的地方都已经被反复搜查过了。

sentences.en: Every street combed.
sentences.zh: 每一条街道都经过了地毯式搜寻。

sentences.en: Every house visited.
sentences.zh: 每一栋房子都走访过了。

sentences.en: Police operations wound down as the incident room moved from the Mollseed family home to the Rochdale Police Station.
sentences.zh: 随着指挥部从莫尔西德一家的住所搬到罗奇代尔警察局，警方行动开始逐步缩减。

sentences.en: The stress was taking its toll on the entire community.
sentences.zh: 这种压力正在对整个社区造成严重的心理负担。

sentences.en: Search parties were disbanded.
sentences.zh: 搜救队解散了。

sentences.en: Vigils had come to an end.
sentences.zh: 守夜活动也结束了。

sentences.en: And the Mollseeds were faced with the overwhelming realisation that their Lel might never come home.
sentences.zh: 而莫尔西德一家不得不面对一个残酷的现实——他们的莱尔可能再也回不了家了。

sentences.en: David Greenwell, a joiner by trade, was working a refitting job for a Rochdale jewellery shop at the time of Leslie's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 戴维·格林韦本职是一名细木工，在莱斯利失踪期间，他正在罗奇代尔一家珠宝店负责装修工作。

sentences.en: His home was a two-hour drive southeast in Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 他的家在东南方向两小时车程外的诺丁汉。

sentences.en: Instead of making the four-hour return trip from Nottingham each day, Greenwell slept in Rochdale Monday to Thursday and returned home on weekends.
sentences.zh: 格林韦没有每天从诺丁汉进行四小时的往返奔波，而是周一到周四住在罗奇代尔，周末再回诺丁汉的家。

sentences.en: To save on hotels, he slept in the back of his yellow minivan, which he'd park in a quiet lay-by sheltered by a hill just off the A672 motorway.
sentences.zh: 为了节省旅馆费用，他睡在黄色小面包车的后厢里，车子就停在A672高速公路旁一个被小山遮挡的安静港湾里。

sentences.en: A lay-by is a public rest area located next to large thoroughfares, such as motorways.
sentences.zh: 港湾是位于高速公路等交通要道旁边的公共休息区。

sentences.en: Early on Wednesday October 8, Greenwell woke in his van.
sentences.zh: 10月8日星期三清晨，格林韦在车里醒来。

sentences.en: Feeling the urge to relieve himself, he scaled the hill, looking for somewhere out of sight of passing motorists.
sentences.zh: 由于感到内急，他爬上了小山坡，寻找一处避开过往司机视线的地方。

sentences.en: He found a flat moor covered in bracken and wild grass about 12 metres above.
sentences.zh: 他在大约12米高的地方发现了一片长满蕨类植物和野草的平坦荒原。

sentences.en: Through the low-lying fog, a blue shape lying in the grass caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 透过低矮的晨雾，草丛中一个蓝色的身影吸引了他的注意。

sentences.en: Greenwell moved closer to inspect it.
sentences.zh: 格林韦走近去查看。

sentences.en: His stomach lurched.
sentences.zh: 他的胃一阵翻江倒海。

sentences.en: There was a blue raincoat attached to the body of a small child, face down and unmoving.
sentences.zh: 那是一具面朝下趴着、一动不动的小孩尸体，身上穿着一件蓝色雨衣。

sentences.en: In shock, Greenwell scrambled back down the hillside to his van.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的格林韦连滚带爬地跑回山坡下的面包车。

sentences.en: He drove to the jewellery shop, arriving just after 8am.
sentences.zh: 他开车前往那家珠宝店，到达时刚过早上8点。

sentences.en: Colleagues immediately sensed something was seriously wrong.
sentences.zh: 同事们立刻察觉到出了什么大事。

sentences.en: Pale and shaken, Greenwell revealed what he discovered on the moor.
sentences.zh: 脸色苍白、浑身发抖的格林韦说出了他在荒原上发现的情况。

sentences.en: They immediately called the police.
sentences.zh: 他们立即报了警。

sentences.en: At 8.25am, police were cordoning off the lay-by and surrounding moor.
sentences.zh: 早上8点25分，警察已经拉起警戒线，封锁了港湾和周围的荒原。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Superintendent Jack Dibb, head of West Yorkshire Law Enforcement, and Dick Holland, his junior officer from the town of Halifax, arrived to the scene.
sentences.zh: 西约克郡执法局局长、高级警司杰克·迪布和来自哈利法克斯镇的下属警官迪克·霍兰德抵达了现场。

sentences.en: The body was that of a young girl with pale, freckled skin and curly brown hair.
sentences.zh: 死者是一个皮肤白皙、长着雀斑和一头棕色卷发的年轻女孩。

sentences.en: She was wearing a blue-hooded raincoat, a pink skirt and tartan socks.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件带帽子的蓝色雨衣、一条粉色裙子和格子袜。

sentences.en: None of her clothing was disturbed.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服没有遭到任何翻动。

sentences.en: A navy blue, Tweety Bird bag lay empty at her feet, and a purple sequined purse was found near her body.
sentences.zh: 她脚边放着一个空空的深蓝色崔弟鸟包，尸体附近还发现了一个紫色亮片钱包。

sentences.en: It was unzipped and empty.
sentences.zh: 拉链开着，里面空无一物。

sentences.en: There was little doubt.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么悬念了。

sentences.en: Leslie Mulsied had been found.
sentences.zh: 失踪的莱斯利·莫尔西德已经被找到。

sentences.en: The murder weapon appeared to be a small knife with a thin blade half an inch wide and two and a half inches long.
sentences.zh: 凶器似乎是一把小刀，刀刃很薄，宽半英寸，长两英寸半。

sentences.en: Twelve stab wounds cut through Leslie's clothes into her back, shoulders, neck and head.
sentences.zh: 十二处刀伤穿透莱斯利的衣服，刺入她的背部、肩膀、颈部和头部。

sentences.en: All strikes occurred from behind.
sentences.zh: 所有的袭击都是从背后发起的。

sentences.en: There were no defensive wounds.
sentences.zh: 身上没有任何防卫伤。

sentences.en: A smear of blood was found on her left thigh.
sentences.zh: 她的左大腿上发现了一抹血迹。

sentences.en: Police believed the perpetrator wiped the knife clean there after the attack.
sentences.zh: 警方认为凶手在袭击后在那里把凶器上的血迹擦干净了。

sentences.en: Forensic scientists were unable to determine an exact time of death.
sentences.zh: 法医未能确定具体的死亡时间。

sentences.en: It could have occurred at any time during the three days Leslie was missing.
sentences.zh: 它可能发生在莱斯利失踪三天的任何一个时间段里。

sentences.en: No fingerprints or blood samples were found.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现指纹或血样。

sentences.en: Light semen staining was found on the outside surface of her underwear and skirt.
sentences.zh: 在她的内衣和裙子外表面发现了微量的精液痕迹。

sentences.en: However, there had been no penetrative sexual attack.
sentences.zh: 然而，并没有发生过插入式的性侵袭击。

sentences.en: The sample was of insufficient quantity to determine a blood type.
sentences.zh: 样本量太少，无法确定血型。

sentences.en: And in 1975, DNA profiling didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 而且在1975年，DNA基因图谱技术尚未问世。

sentences.en: As the morning wore on, a cold westerly wind picked up along the moors.
sentences.zh: 随着清晨过去，荒原上刮起了寒冷的西风。

sentences.en: With each sweeping gust, important evidence such as particles or fibres were at risk of being blown away.
sentences.zh: 伴随着每一阵强风，诸如微粒或纤维等重要证据都有被吹走的风险。

sentences.en: Sellotape was rubbed against Leslie's clothing to lift any fibres before the wind claimed them.
sentences.zh: 人们用透明胶带在莱斯利的衣服上按压，以便在风吹走纤维之前将它们提取下来。

sentences.en: Two bright yellow wool fibres were found on her jumper and an orange rayon fibre on her right sock.
sentences.zh: 在她的毛衣上发现了两根亮黄色羊毛纤维，右袜子上一根橙色人造丝纤维。

sentences.en: Trace of a white powder was also found on Leslie's clothing.
sentences.zh: 在莱斯利的衣服上还发现了白色粉末的痕迹。

sentences.en: It was identified as containing maize starch, an ingredient in wallpaper paste.
sentences.zh: 经鉴定，其中含有玉米淀粉，这是墙纸胶水的一种成分。

sentences.en: Investigators combed the moor for evidence.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在荒原上梳理寻找证据。

sentences.en: The area was littered with rubbish discarded by passing cars or swept up from elsewhere and carried downwind.
sentences.zh: 该区域到处都是过往车辆丢弃的垃圾，或是从别处被风卷起并吹到这里的杂物。

sentences.en: Police collected what they could find, including empty bottles, cigarette packets, handkerchiefs, a sock and a blue pen with a white cap.
sentences.zh: 警方收集了他们能找到的东西，包括空瓶子、烟盒、手帕、一只袜子以及一支带白帽的蓝色钢笔。

sentences.en: In total, 379 items were collected in and around the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 总共在犯罪现场及其周边收集到了379件物品。

sentences.en: One of these items stood out, a broken knife found near the lay-by.
sentences.zh: 其中有一件物品格外引人注目，是在港湾附近发现的一把断刀。

sentences.en: However, tests later revealed it was not the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 然而，后来的测试表明它并不是凶器。

sentences.en: The man who found Leslie, David Greenwell, was at his home in Nottingham the day of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 发现莱斯利的男子戴维·格林韦在她失踪当天正在诺丁汉的家中。

sentences.en: And police quickly eliminated him as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 警方很快排除了他的嫌疑。

sentences.en: When the police car came to a gentle stop out the front of their Delamere Road home, the Mulseids knew their little lel had finally been found.
sentences.zh: 当警车在他们德拉米尔路住宅门前缓缓停下时，莫尔西德一家就知道他们的小莱尔终于找到了。

sentences.en: The investigation into the murder of Leslie Mulseid was kick-started by 100 police officers from West Yorkshire and Greater Manchester.
sentences.zh: 对莱斯利·莫尔西德谋杀案的调查由来自西约克郡和大曼彻斯特的100名警官共同启动。

sentences.en: They were powered by mounting pressure to find Leslie's killer as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们面临着尽快找到莱斯利凶手的巨大压力。

sentences.en: With no witnesses having heard signs of a struggle in Stiops Lane, where Leslie disappeared,
sentences.zh: 由于没有目击者在莱斯利失踪的斯蒂奥普斯巷听到过任何挣扎的迹象，

sentences.en: police considered the possibility Leslie was lured away by someone she knew and trusted.
sentences.zh: 警方开始考虑莱斯利是被她认识且信任的人诱骗走的可能性。

sentences.en: Local traders, ice cream men, milkmen, youth group assistants, taxi drivers, even Leslie's school bus driver, were all interviewed as potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 当地的商贩、冰淇淋小贩、送奶工、青年团契助理、出租车司机，甚至是莱斯利的校车司机，都被作为潜在嫌疑人进行了盘问。

sentences.en: The grieving Mulseid family also felt the heat of the investigators' spotlight.
sentences.zh: 悲痛欲绝的莫尔西德家族也感受到了调查人员聚光灯下的压力。

sentences.en: Their personal lives were exposed and scrutinised for any hint to a motive for Leslie's death.
sentences.zh: 他们的私生活被曝光并受到审视，以寻找莱斯利死因动机的任何蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: Leslie's mother, April Mulseid, was originally married to Frederick Anderson, who was the biological father of Leslie and her three siblings.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利的母亲阿普丽尔·莫尔西德最初嫁给了弗雷德里克·安德森，后者是莱斯利及她三个兄弟姐妹的生父。

sentences.en: April believed Frederick did not adjust well to his role as a father.
sentences.zh: 阿普丽尔认为弗雷德里克并没有很好地适应父亲的角色。

sentences.en: Tensions peaked when Leslie was born, whose ill health demanded more time and attention.
sentences.zh: 当莱斯利出生时，矛盾达到了顶峰，由于莱斯利身体不好，需要更多的时间和照顾。

sentences.en: One day, Frederick snapped and stormed out of the family home in a temper.
sentences.zh: 一天，弗雷德里克情绪崩溃，气冲冲地冲出了家门。

sentences.en: As her relationship with Frederick deteriorated, April found comfort in Danny Mulseid.
sentences.zh: 随着与弗雷德里克的关系恶化，阿普丽尔在丹尼·莫尔西德身上找到了慰藉。

sentences.en: Danny was far more compassionate towards her children, especially Leslie.
sentences.zh: 丹尼对她的孩子们要富有同情心得多，尤其是对莱斯利。

sentences.en: Torn between both men, April decided to fix her broken marriage.
sentences.zh: 在两个男人之间左右为难的阿普丽尔决定修复她破碎的婚姻。

sentences.en: The Andersons moved to Delamere Road, where old tensions were revived.
sentences.zh: 安德森一家搬到了德拉米尔路，往日的矛盾在那里死灰复燃。

sentences.en: This resulted in April being hospitalised for psychiatric treatment.
sentences.zh: 这导致阿普丽尔因精神治疗而住院。

sentences.en: Upon her release, Danny moved into the Delamere Road house to help her recover, causing April's husband, Frederick, to leave.
sentences.zh: 在她出院后，丹尼搬进了德拉米尔路的房子来帮助她康复，这导致阿普丽尔的丈夫弗雷德里克离家出走。

sentences.en: Frederick and April divorced in 1972.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克和阿普丽尔于1972年离婚。

sentences.en: Afterwards, April and Danny settled into a relationship, and in early 1975 they married.
sentences.zh: 此后，阿普丽尔和丹尼确定了恋爱关系，并于1975年初结婚。

sentences.en: Wedded bliss was fleeting, though.
sentences.zh: 然而，新婚的快乐总是短暂的。

sentences.en: Danny lost his job, and the family were overwhelmed with debt.
sentences.zh: 丹尼失去了工作，一家人陷入了巨额债务之中。

sentences.en: Danny also had a tumultuous relationship with his older stepdaughter, 16-year-old Julie.
sentences.zh: 丹尼与他16岁的长继女朱莉的关系也十分动荡。

sentences.en: The two were always in conflict as Danny drew issue with Julie's boyfriends, causing the pair to have intense arguments.
sentences.zh: 两人总是冲突不断，因为丹尼对朱莉的男朋友有意见，导致两人经常发生激烈的争吵。

sentences.en: Julie moved out of the Delamere Road property to live with her biological father, Frederick.
sentences.zh: 朱莉搬出了德拉米尔路的房子，去和她的生父弗雷德里克同住。

sentences.en: Instability led both April and Danny to alcohol.
sentences.zh: 生活的动荡让阿普丽尔和丹尼都借酒浇愁。

sentences.en: When social services visited the Mollseed house after a call from a concerned neighbour, they found the young children home alone, and April and Danny at the pub.
sentences.zh: 当社会福利机构接到热心邻居的电话走访莫尔西德家时，他们发现幼小的孩子们独自在家，而阿普丽尔和丹尼却在酒吧里。

sentences.en: Stresses didn't dissipate when Danny finally found work.
sentences.zh: 当丹尼终于找到工作时，生活压力并未消散。

sentences.en: Debt still overshadowed their daily lives, forcing the Mollseed family to start borrowing money from friends and neighbours.
sentences.zh: 债务依然阴云密布地笼罩着他们的日常生活，迫使莫尔西德一家开始向朋友和邻居借钱。

sentences.en: But people soon stopped lending them money, because they were never paid back.
sentences.zh: 但人们很快就不再借钱给他们了，因为他们从来没有还过钱。

sentences.en: The Mollseeds were far from an ordinary stable suburban family.
sentences.zh: 莫尔西德一家绝不是一个普通的稳定郊区家庭。

sentences.en: With divorce, debt and drinking problems, as well as the added demands of an unwell child, a possible motive was established.
sentences.zh: 伴随着离婚、债务、酗酒问题，再加上照顾生病孩子的额外负担，一个可能的动机就此确立了。

sentences.en: Although it was shaky.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个动机并不牢靠。

sentences.en: No one was fully convinced the Mollseed family would intentionally harm Leslie.
sentences.zh: 没有人完全确信莫尔西德一家会蓄意伤害莱斯利。

sentences.en: Danny Mollseed had proven when provoked he could have a temper with his stepchildren.
sentences.zh: 丹尼·莫尔西德曾证明，在被激怒时，他对继子女确实会有暴脾气。

sentences.en: Did something happen causing him to snap and lash out at Leslie?
sentences.zh: 是不是发生了什么事导致他情绪失控并对莱斯利大打出手？

sentences.en: It wasn't impossible, but it didn't seem likely.
sentences.zh: 这并非不可能，但看起来不太像是真的。

sentences.en: Danny admitted Leslie was his favourite, and therefore she was the least likely target of his frustration.
sentences.zh: 丹尼承认莱斯利是他的最爱，因此她最不可能是他发泄 frustartion（挫折感）的目标。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, as more of a precaution,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，出于谨慎起见，

sentences.en: Danny Mollseed was added to the list of suspects in Leslie's murder.
sentences.zh: 丹尼·莫尔西德还是被列入了莱斯利谋杀案的嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: By October 10, with no suspects in custody, an additional 100 police officers joined the investigation.
sentences.zh: 到10月10日，由于仍无嫌疑人被捕，又有100名警官加入了调查。

sentences.en: They followed up on 400 calls that had come in from the public.
sentences.zh: 他们跟进了公众打来的400个电话线索。

sentences.en: Descriptions of cars seen in the vicinity of Turf Hill Estate were taken.
sentences.zh: 警方收集了特夫希尔庄园附近发现的汽车描述。

sentences.en: Of particular focus was the lay-by and more where Leslie's body was found.
sentences.zh: 重点关注的是发现莱斯利尸体的港湾和荒原。

sentences.en: Motorists who travelled along the A672 motorway in the previous days were asked to come forward with descriptions of cars they had seen at or near the lay-by on the A672.
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁在过去几天里行驶在A672高速公路上的司机们提供他们在A672港湾或其附近看到的汽车描述。

sentences.en: Each vehicle was traced and ruled out.
sentences.zh: 每一辆车都被追踪并排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Except two.
sentences.zh: 除了两辆。

sentences.en: A cream four-door car with a red primer pane on the doors was seen on the Sunday of Leslie's disappearance within a kilometre of Delamere Road.
sentences.zh: 在莱斯利失踪的周日，在距离德拉米尔路一公里范围内，曾有人看到一辆车门带有红色底漆斑块的米色四门轿车。

sentences.en: A Turf Hill Estate resident spotted the vehicle at around 1.30pm.
sentences.zh: 特夫希尔庄园的一位居民在大约下午1点30分发现了这辆车。

sentences.en: She claimed to have seen a young girl in the car's passenger seat looking down.
sentences.zh: 她声称看到车内副驾驶座上坐着一个低着头的小女孩。

sentences.en: The witness was convinced the young girl was Leslie Mollseed.
sentences.zh: 目击者坚信那个小女孩就是莱斯利·莫尔西德。

sentences.en: Two men saw the same cream-coloured car that afternoon but were unable to say if there were any children in it.
sentences.zh: 两名男子那天下午也看到了同一辆米色汽车，但无法确定车里是否有儿童。

sentences.en: They identified it as old, possibly a 1964 Vauxhall Viva.
sentences.zh: 他们辨认出这是一辆旧车，可能是一辆1964款沃克斯豪尔维瓦（Vauxhall Viva）。

sentences.en: A similar car was described by two more witnesses who spotted it at the lay-by between 6.15 and 6.45pm that night.
sentences.zh: 另有两位目击者描述了一辆类似的汽车，他们在当晚6点15分到6点45分之间看到它停在港湾。

sentences.en: The second vehicle yet to be identified and ruled out was a dirty, hand-painted, turquoise-coloured Morris Minor 1000 minivan.
sentences.zh: 第二辆尚未被确认和排除嫌疑的车辆是一辆脏兮兮的、手工喷漆的蓝绿色莫里斯微型1000（Morris Minor 1000）面包车。

sentences.en: A total of 14 witnesses described seeing this van in the Turf Hill Estate on the Sunday Leslie disappeared.
sentences.zh: 总共有14名目击者描述在莱斯利失踪的周日看到这辆面包车出现在特夫希尔庄园。

sentences.en: The sightings covered a period between 1.30 and 6.30pm.
sentences.zh: 目击时间跨度从下午1点30分到6点30分。

sentences.en: It was also seen parked at the lay-by between 2pm and 3.30pm with a green tartan blanket draped across the windshield.
sentences.zh: 它还被发现在下午2点到3点30分之间停在港湾，挡风玻璃上盖着一条绿色格子毯子。

sentences.en: A police request for the owners of the cream-coloured Vauxhall Viva and the hand-painted turquoise Morris Minor minivan went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 警方寻找米色沃克斯豪尔维瓦和手工喷漆蓝绿色莫里斯微型面包车车主的呼吁没有得到任何回应。

sentences.en: A team of 20 investigators worked full-time on the search for these two vehicles.
sentences.zh: 一个由20名调查人员组成的小组全职致力于搜寻这两辆车。

sentences.en: Rochdale local Christopher Coverdale drove past the A672 motorway lay-by the Sunday Leslie was abducted.
sentences.zh: 罗奇代尔当地人克里斯托弗·科弗代尔在莱斯利被绑架的周日开车经过了A672高速公路港湾。

sentences.en: He approached the lay-by at approximately 1.45pm when he saw a man on the embankment facing the road and reaching downwards.
sentences.zh: 他在下午1点45分左右靠近港湾时，看到路堤上有一个男人正面对着马路往下伸手。

sentences.en: The Caucasian man was approximately 5 foot 6 inches tall, plump, between 30 and 35 years old, with light brown or fair-coloured hair that looked to be receding.
sentences.zh: 这个白人男子身高约5英尺6英寸，身材丰满，年龄在30到35岁之间，留着浅棕色或浅色头发，看起来有些秃顶。

sentences.en: He wore a brown jacket in a Czech pattern, matching trousers, and a beige or mustard yellow cardigan.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件捷克图案的棕色夹克、配套的裤子，以及一件米色或芥末黄色的开衫。

sentences.en: He was reaching down to the outstretched hand of a female child below.
sentences.zh: 他正俯身够着下面一个小女孩伸出的手。

sentences.en: She was wearing a blue raincoat with the hood up over her head.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件蓝色雨衣，兜帽戴在头上。

sentences.en: The girl was not being dragged up the hillside against her will, and Christopher assumed the pair were related, perhaps stretching their legs after a long road trip
sentences.zh: 女孩并不是违背意愿被拖上山坡的，克里斯托弗认为两人是一对，可能是在长途旅行后放松双腿

sentences.en: or wanting to check out the view of the moors.
sentences.zh: 或者想要欣赏荒野的风景。

sentences.en: The scene didn't raise any red flags at the time, but after hearing about Leslie Mollseed,
sentences.zh: 当时这一幕并没有引起任何警惕，但在听说莱斯利·莫尔西德的事之后，

sentences.en: Christopher immediately came forward with this information.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗立即主动提供了这一信息。

sentences.en: Investigators took Christopher Coverdale to the lay-by and asked him to point out where he saw the girl being led to.
sentences.zh: 调查人员带着克里斯托弗·科弗代尔来到路边停车处，请他指出看到女孩被带往的方向。

sentences.en: Christopher motioned to an area near where Leslie Mollseed's body was found.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗指向了发现莱斯利·莫尔西德尸体附近的一个区域。

sentences.en: By October 15, a week had passed since Leslie's body had been found.
sentences.zh: 到10月15日，距离发现莱斯利尸体已经过去了一周。

sentences.en: No arrests had been made, so another 100 police officers were added to the investigation, raising the total to 300 officers actively working on the case.
sentences.zh: 尚未有人被捕，因此调查组又增派了100名警察，使积极参与该案的警力总数达到了300人。

sentences.en: Collectively, they had amassed statements from 14,000 members of the public, including Christopher Coverdale's chilling statement
sentences.zh: 他们总共收集了来自14000名公众的陈述，其中包括克里斯托弗·科弗代尔令人不寒栗的陈述

sentences.en: of the man leading the young girl up the embankment at the A672 lay-by.
sentences.zh: 关于那个在A672路边停车处旁边的路堤上带小女孩上山的男子。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Superintendent Jack Dibb fronted the media and expressed the opinion of law enforcement that the motive for Leslie's killing was definitely sexual.
sentences.zh: 侦探总总督察杰克·迪布面对媒体，表达了执法部门的看法，即杀害莱斯利的动机绝对是出于性目的。

sentences.en: The person responsible was beyond just the pedophile, but someone, quote,
sentences.zh: 作案者不仅是个恋童癖，而且是一个，引述的话来说，

sentences.en: Investigators visited mental health facilities and psychiatric wards and checked for patients who were released or had escaped the weekend of October 5.
sentences.zh: 调查人员走访了心理健康设施和精神病房，并排查了在10月5日那个周末获释或逃跑的患者。

sentences.en: Crime reports in the greater Manchester area were looked into to determine if Leslie was targeted by a serial offender that may have attacked other victiMs.
sentences.zh: 大曼彻斯特地区的犯罪报告受到了调查，以确定莱斯利是否成了可能袭击过其他受害者的连环罪犯的目标。

sentences.en: They found several reports that piqued their intereSt.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了几份引起他们兴趣的报告。

sentences.en: Two months before Leslie's murder, on the morning of August 12 in Miles Platting, two young sisters were hunched over a canal fishing.
sentences.zh: 在莱斯利遇害两个月前，即8月12日上午在米尔斯普拉廷，两个年轻的姐妹正弯着腰在运河边钓鱼。

sentences.en: They were approached by a man who abducted one of them and assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 一个男子接近了她们，绑架了其中一人并对她实施了袭击。

sentences.en: He returned her to the canal after the attack.
sentences.zh: 袭击后，他把她送回了运河边。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, October 7, two days after Leslie had disappeared, a six-year-old girl in Denton was assaulted.
sentences.zh: 10月7日星期二，即莱斯利失踪两天后，登顿发生了一起针对一名六岁女孩的袭击事件。

sentences.en: An unidentified man offering sweets lured the girl into a brown car described by a witness as a four-door Cortina.
sentences.zh: 一名提供糖果的身份不明男子将女孩诱入一辆棕色汽车，目击者描述该车为四门科蒂娜。

sentences.en: The girl was taken to a secluded road where she was indecently assaulted before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 女孩被带到一个偏僻的道路上，在那里遭到猥亵，随后逃脱。

sentences.en: Then in Stockport, a man attempted to drag a 13-year-old girl into his car, but she managed to free herself and escape.
sentences.zh: 接着在斯托克波特，一名男子试图将一名13岁的女孩拖入他的车内，但她设法挣脱并逃跑了。

sentences.en: Detective Jack Dibb recognised there were notable differences between each of these attacks and Leslie Mollseed's murder, but believed it would be foolish
sentences.zh: 侦探杰克·迪布承认，这些袭击事件与莱斯利·莫尔西德的谋杀案之间存在显著差异，但他认为

sentences.en: to completely disregard a link.
sentences.zh: 完全忽视两者之间的联系是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: Closer to Rochdale, residents were hyper-vigilant.
sentences.zh: 越靠近罗奇代尔，居民们的防范意识就越高。

sentences.en: The sooner Leslie's killer was caught, the sooner they'd regain their sense of safety.
sentences.zh: 越早抓住莱斯利的杀手，他们就能越快找回安全感。

sentences.en: The police were never short on reports of suspicious behaviour and sexual deviance.
sentences.zh: 警方从不缺乏关于可疑行为和性变态的报告。

sentences.en: Teachers reported a tall, slim man taking photographs of children in the school playground.
sentences.zh: 老师们报告说，有一个身材高瘦的男子在学校操场上给孩子们拍照。

sentences.en: Lone female travellers reported male drivers offering them lifts.
sentences.zh: 独自旅行的女性报告说有男司机主动提出让她们搭车。

sentences.en: A report came in about a man who exposed himself to a woman and another of a man caught masturbating in public.
sentences.zh: 收到了一份关于一名男子向女性暴露身体的报告，以及另一份关于一名男子被发现在公共场合自慰的报告。

sentences.en: The investigator's suspect profile for Leslie's killer was basic.
sentences.zh: 调查人员对莱斯利杀手的嫌疑人画像很简单。

sentences.en: Male, post-puberty, with access to a car.
sentences.zh: 男性，青春期后，有车可用。

sentences.en: But they were also open to the possibility more than one person may have been involved, including a female accomplice used to lure Leslie.
sentences.zh: 但他们也对不止一人涉案的可能性持开放态度，包括用来引诱莱斯利的女性同伙。

sentences.en: This was, of course, the MO of serial killers
sentences.zh: 当然，这正是连环杀手的作案手法

sentences.en: Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, who were active 10 years earlier, as covered in Case 49 of Casefire.
sentences.zh: 米拉·欣德利和伊恩·布雷迪，他们在10年前活跃过，正如“案发现场”第49案中所报道的那样。

sentences.en: As the investigation continued, two teenage girls from the Turf Hill estate approached police with some startling news.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的继续，来自特夫希尔住宅区的两个十几岁女孩向警方提供了一些令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: They claimed to have seen Leslie Mollseed between 8 and 8.15pm the Sunday she went missing.
sentences.zh: 她们声称在莱斯利失踪那个周日的晚上8点到8点15分之间看到了她。

sentences.en: The girls were waiting for their boyfriends, who were in a nearby supermarket.
sentences.zh: 女孩们当时正在等她们的男朋友，他们的男朋友在附近的超市里。

sentences.en: They said they spotted Leslie walking alone just outside the estate.
sentences.zh: 她们说看到莱斯利独自一人走在住宅区外围。

sentences.en: The girls had a short conversation with Leslie and afterwards she walked off towards Rochdale Town Centre.
sentences.zh: 女孩们与莱斯利简短地交谈了几句，之后她朝着罗奇代尔市中心方向走去。

sentences.en: This was the first reported sighting of Leslie beyond Stuyup's Lane.
sentences.zh: 这是第一起报告的在斯蒂尤普巷之外看到莱斯利的目击记录。

sentences.en: This sighting rattled the entire investigation.
sentences.zh: 这次目击让整个调查陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: Previous statements were now in question.
sentences.zh: 先前的陈述现在受到了质疑。
